name: @searchgres/server
description: Bun JSON-RPC server for one searchgres index.

scripts.build: bun run bundle:tokenizer-worker && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp src/tokenizer.worker.generated.cjs dist/tokenizer.worker.generated.cjs
scripts.test:unit: bun run bundle:tokenizer-worker && find src -name '*.test.ts' ! -name '*.integration.test.ts' -print0 | xargs -0 bun test
